name: opencode
description: OpenCode terminal AI coding agent. Non-interactive mode (opencode run) IS real and documented - but it requires the OpenCode CLI BINARY, not the Electron desktop .exe (which just opens the GUI when passed args).
binary_note: The installed desktop app (C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Programs\@opencode-aidesktop\OpenCode.exe) is the Electron GUI - passing 'run' args to it opens a window, not headless output. The CLI is a SEPARATE binary: install via 'curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash' (or npm/bun/brew), giving a real 'opencode' command. The desktop app may also bundle it under its resources/app.asar.unpacked/node_modules - if found, point cmd_bin at that opencode(.exe/.cmd). Set cmd_bin below before enabling.
capabilities: Headless task run with captured JSON output
Path-confined edits (only via an approved workspace + approved agent)

headless.flag_notes: CORRECTED from first draft: JSON output is --format json (NOT -f json; -f/--file attaches files). There is NO --mode flag on 'run' - safe read-only behavior comes from a permission-scoped AGENT, not a mode flag. --auto auto-approves permissions (build only). --dir confines the working directory.
setup_agents: opencode agent create --path .opencode/agent --description 'Pip read-only planner' --mode subagent --permissions read,grep,glob,webfetch
opencode agent create --path .opencode/agent --description 'Pip scoped builder' --mode subagent --permissions read,grep,glob,edit,bash
headless.note: The read-only agent DENIES edit+bash (anything omitted from --permissions is denied), so even with --auto it cannot write or run commands - that is the real safe 'plan' guarantee, stronger than a mode flag.

handoff_guidance: REQUIRES the opencode CLI binary - the desktop .exe will not do headless. Confirm cmd_bin resolves before enabling.
Default to the pip-readonly agent (read/grep/glob/webfetch only): captured output, no writes, fully reversible.
The pip-build agent (adds edit+bash) plus --auto can write and run commands unsupervised - only inside an approved --dir workspace AND behind an explicit human-approved handoff.
Capture stdout (--format json), summarize in Pip's voice, text the result - like the deep-research bridge.
